name: Trove
description: Reference tools for underused public healthcare data. Two Claude skills: hcris-analyst looks up nonprofit U.S. hospital reporting (CMS S-10 vs. IRS 990 Schedule H, side by side) and fda-analyst looks up FDA novel drug approvals 2021–2024 with links to the approval-package PDFs.
longDescription:
Ships **2 skills**, `fda-analyst` (Answer questions about FDA drug approvals — the basis for approval, the trials, the endpoints, the regulatory pathway,…), `hcris-analyst` (Answer questions about U.S).

Installs with `claude plugin install trove@claude-community` from `cbetz/trove`.
